title: Keepa product response
description: Response of the Keepa /product API. The csv array is the motivating case for schema hints: it is a fixed-layout array whose slots are identified only by position.

timestamp.title: Response timestamp
timestamp.description: When Keepa generated this response, in Unix epoch milliseconds — unlike the product-level time fields, which are in Keepa minutes.

tokensLeft.title: Tokens left
tokensLeft.description: API tokens remaining on the account after this request.

refillIn.title: Refill in
refillIn.description: Milliseconds until the next token refill.

tokenFlowReduction.title: Token flow reduction
tokenFlowReduction.description: How much this request temporarily lowers the refill rate, in tokens per minute. Sits alongside refillRate rather than replacing it: the effective rate is the refill rate less this reduction.

processingTimeInMs.title: Processing time
processingTimeInMs.description: Server-side time to build this response, in milliseconds.

trackingSince.title: Tracking since
trackingSince.description: First time Keepa saw this product, in Keepa minutes (minutes since 2011-01-01 UTC).

lastUpdate.title: Last update
lastUpdate.description: Last time this product's data changed, in Keepa minutes.

lastPriceChange.title: Last price change
lastPriceChange.description: Last time any price on this product moved, in Keepa minutes.

lastRatingUpdate.title: Last rating update
lastRatingUpdate.description: Last time the rating or review count changed, in Keepa minutes.

listedSince.title: Listed since
listedSince.description: When the product was first listed on Amazon, in Keepa minutes.

oneOf.title: Standard
oneOf.description: A physical product with its own listing.

oneOf.title: eBook
oneOf.description: A Kindle or other electronic book.

oneOf.title: Unknown
oneOf.description: Keepa could not determine the type.

oneOf.title: Variation parent
oneOf.description: A parent listing whose variations are the real products.

oneOf.title: No Amazon offer
oneOf.description: Amazon does not sell this product.

oneOf.title: Pre-orderable
oneOf.description: Not in stock yet; orderable in advance.

oneOf.title: Unknown
oneOf.description: Amazon states no availability for this offer.

oneOf.title: Backorderable
oneOf.description: Out of stock; orders are queued until it returns.

oneOf.title: Delayed
oneOf.description: Shipping is delayed beyond the usual window.

offers.title: Marketplace offers
offers.description: Returned only when the request's offers parameter is used. Keepa retrieves the best offers as sorted by Amazon; if a product has more offers than requested, the rest are absent. The list mixes live and historic offers — check lastSeen, or use liveOffersOrder.

liveOffersOrder.title: Live offer order
liveOffersOrder.description: Positions in the offers array of the currently live offers, in Amazon's order — the documented alternative to filtering on each offer's lastSeen yourself.

csv.title: Price and rank history
csv.description: One entry per data type, each an alternating [Keepa minute, value] series. Prices are in the locale's smallest currency unit; -1 means 'no data at that time'.

prefixItems.title: Amazon price
prefixItems.description: Price of the Amazon offer itself.

prefixItems.title: New price
prefixItems.description: Lowest new marketplace price, excluding shipping.

prefixItems.title: Used price
prefixItems.description: Lowest used marketplace price, excluding shipping.

prefixItems.title: Sales rank
prefixItems.description: Sales rank in the product's root category.

prefixItems.title: New, FBM
prefixItems.description: Lowest new price from a merchant-fulfilled offer, including shipping.

prefixItems.title: New, FBA
prefixItems.description: Lowest new price from a Fulfilled-by-Amazon offer.

prefixItems.title: Extra info updates
prefixItems.description: When Keepa last refreshed the extended product data.

prefixItems.title: Used, like new
prefixItems.description: Lowest 'used - like new' price including shipping.

prefixItems.title: Used, very good
prefixItems.description: Lowest 'used - very good' price including shipping.

prefixItems.title: Collectible, like new
prefixItems.description: Lowest 'collectible - like new' price including shipping.

prefixItems.title: Collectible, very good
prefixItems.description: Lowest 'collectible - very good' price including shipping.

offer.title: Marketplace offer
offer.description: One marketplace offer: its seller, condition, Prime/FBA flags, coupons, and price/shipping/stock history. Offers are often outdated — the same offer keeps its offerId across requests, but the order changes and coverage has gaps.

offerId.title: Offer ID
offerId.description: Unique within this product, and stable across requests, so the same offer can be tracked over time. Unrelated to Amazon's own offer IDs, which are user-specific and short-lived.

lastSeen.title: Last seen
lastSeen.description: Last time this offer was seen and updated, in Keepa minutes. Check this before treating an offer as live.

sellerId.title: Seller ID
sellerId.description: Merchant's seller ID, e.g. A2L77EE7U53NWQ for Amazon.com Warehouse Deals.

isPrime.title: Prime
isPrime.description: Available via Prime shipping. Keepa cannot reliably identify Seller Fulfilled Prime.

isMAP.title: MAP restricted
isMAP.description: Price is hidden on Amazon under a minimum-advertised-price restriction. The price and shipping cost are still present here.

isShippable.title: Shippable
isShippable.description: Currently shippable. If not, it may be temporarily out of stock, or a pre-order.

isWarehouseDeal.title: Warehouse Deal
isWarehouseDeal.description: The offer is an Amazon Warehouse Deal.

isAmazon.title: Sold by Amazon
isAmazon.description: The seller is Amazon itself. Warehouse Deals, and other accounts Amazon runs under a different name, do not count.

isPrimeExcl.title: Prime exclusive
isPrimeExcl.description: This offer has a discounted Prime exclusive price.

coupon.title: Coupon
coupon.description: One-time coupon on this offer, absent if there is none. Positive is an absolute discount in the locale's smallest currency unit (500 = $5 off); negative is a percentage (-15 = 15% off).

couponHistory.title: Coupon history
couponHistory.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, coupon] pairs, same coupon encoding as the coupon field.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Open Box conditions are coded as Used conditions.

oneOf.title: Unknown
oneOf.description: Keepa could not determine the condition.

conditionComment.title: Condition comment
conditionComment.description: The seller's free-text description of the condition. Absent if unavailable.

minOrderQty.title: Minimum order quantity
minOrderQty.description: Only present when the offer sets one.

lastStockUpdate.title: Last stock update
lastStockUpdate.description: Most recent update of this offer's stock data, in Keepa minutes.

offerCSV.title: Price and shipping history
offerCSV.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, price, shipping cost] triples — the last three entries are the current values. Price and shipping are in the locale's smallest currency unit (cents, yen). Shipping 0 means free shipping; -1 means not shippable or unspecified shipping; -2 in either slot means the value could not be determined.

stockCSV.title: Stock history
stockCSV.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, stock] pairs. Present only when the request used the stock parameter, and not guaranteed to be available at all. Keepa's best attempt at the quantity — it can be wrong, for instance where per-customer limits apply.

primeExclCSV.title: Prime exclusive price history
primeExclCSV.description: Flat series of [Keepa minute, price] pairs, in the locale's smallest currency unit. A price of -1, or a null field, means no Prime exclusive price. Such an offer is only orderable with an active Prime subscription.

offerDuplicates.title: Duplicate offers
offerDuplicates.description: Near-identical offers from the same seller, in the same condition and shipping type, that were dropped from the offers list because they were not the cheapest. Absent if there are none.

price.title: Price
price.description: In the locale's smallest currency unit.

shipping.title: Shipping cost
shipping.description: In the locale's smallest currency unit.
